item.title: Managing the pressure: LNG boil-off gas compression
item.description: In our December 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Daniel Patrick, Market Segment Manager – LNG & Hydrogen, Atlas Copco Gas and Process, highlights the various challenges that boil-off gas compressors face in LNG operations and explores how integrally geared compressors help to tackle them.

item.title: GAZ-SYSTEM considers potential of biomethane
item.description: GAZ-SYSTEM has launched preliminary market consultations concerning the planned purchase of biomethane for use in technological processes.

item.title: Protecting against cascading events
item.description: In our December issue of LNG Industry, a conversation with Alec Cusick, Owens Corning®, showcases passive safety strategies that help mitigate the risk of cascading events in LNG facilities.

item.title: Woodside provides CEO succession
item.description: Woodside CEO and Managing Director, Meg O’Neill, has advised the Board of her resignation and has accepted the role of Chief Executive Officer at bp p.l.c.

item.title: ADNOC secures financing for Hail and Ghasha Gas Development
item.description: ADNOC, in partnership with Eni S.p.A. and PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Ltd, has signed a structured financing transaction of up to US$11 billion to monetise Hail and Ghasha’s midstream future gas production.

item.title: Emissions pooling: Bio-LNG powers emission reductions across European shipping
item.description: Our December issue features an article where Jani Arala, Commercial Manager, Maritime, Gasum, looks at FuelEU Maritime emissions regulations and highlights how the use of bio-LNG and pooling can bring benefits to shipowners and the environment.

item.title: Ocean Yield and NYK Line invest in LNG carriers on long-term charters
item.description: Ocean Yield AS has agreed to co-invest alongside NYK Line in four newbuilding LNG carriers, to be constructed in Korea for deliveries in 2028 – 2029.

item.title: Wärtsilä to divest Gas Solutions business to Mutares SE & Co. KGaA
item.description: Wärtsilä has agreed to divest its Gas Solutions business to the German private equity investor, Mutares SE & Co. KGaA.

item.title: MENA: A region poised to deliver
item.description: In our October 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Chris Strong, Partner, Steven Wilson, Counsel, and Garrett Finch, Associate, Vinson & Elkins, explore the changing role the Middle East and North Africa region will play in the global LNG Industry.

item.title: TT-Line signs contract for new Green Ship 2.0
item.description: TT-Line has signed the contract for the construction of a new Green RoPax vessel.
